definition_en: not deep, not showing serious thought, or breathing with little air
core_image: 目光穿过清澈的浅水，直接看到河底的卵石
scene: 孩子们在浅水里玩耍。The children played in the shallow water.
sceneCN: 这里 shallow 是「浅的」（第 1 个义项）；句意：孩子们在浅水里玩耍。

senses.title: Not deep
senses.definition: having only a short distance from top to bottom
senses.definitionCN: 从上到下的距离很短的
senses.example: The children played in the shallow water.
senses.why: This is the basic physical sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是基本的物理义项。

senses.title: Not serious
senses.definition: lacking deep thought or feeling
senses.definitionCN: 缺乏深刻思想或感情的
senses.example: The book offers only a shallow view.
senses.exampleCN: 这本书只给出浅薄的看法。
senses.why: Depth of water became a metaphor for depth of mind.
senses.whyCN: 水的深度被隐喻为思想的深度。

senses.title: Light breathing
senses.definition: taking in only a little air
senses.example: He was breathing in shallow breaths.
senses.why: Each breath goes only a little way down.
senses.whyCN: 每次呼吸只进入很浅的位置。

senses.title: Shallows
senses.definition: an area of shallow water
senses.example: The boat stuck in the shallows.
senses.why: The adjective became a noun for such a place.
senses.whyCN: 形容词转化为指这种地点的名词。

intro.en: Shallow appears in late Middle English, probably related to Old English words for shoal.
intro.cn: shallow 出现于中古英语晚期，可能与古英语中表示浅滩的词有关。

items.en: Sceald named a shoal or shallow place.
items.cn: sceald 指浅滩或水浅处。

items.en: Schalowe meant not deep.
items.cn: schalowe 意为不深的。

items.en: Shallow described water and containers.
items.cn: shallow 描述水和容器。

items.en: The word described shallow breathing.
items.cn: 这个词描述浅呼吸。

items.en: Shallow became a metaphor for a light mind.
items.cn: shallow 成为思想浅薄的隐喻。

note.en: Shallow is compared with similar-looking words and with words for depth.
note.cn: 把 shallow 与形近词以及表示深度的词作比较。

entries.definition: a dark shape made by light
to take food into the throat

normalIntro.en: Shallow means close to the surface, in water, in breath, or in thought.
normalIntro.cn: shallow 意为靠近表面，无论是水、呼吸还是思想。

normal.en: A shallow mind avoids hard questions.
The boat grounded in the shallows.

abstract.en: Shallow water is easy to cross and easy to see through.
abstract.cn: 浅水容易穿过，也容易看透。

abstract.en: Depth cannot be judged from the surface.
abstract.cn: 深度无法从表面判断。

abstract.en: A shallow answer often ends the question too early.
abstract.cn: 浅薄的回答常让问题过早结束。

examples.en: The children played in the shallow water.
The book offers only a shallow view.
examples.cn: 这本书只给出浅薄的看法。

examples.en: The boat stuck in the shallows.

dict_mnemonic.text: shallow 与 shoal（浅滩）同族，核心义「离表面很近」，由水浅引申为思想浅与呼吸浅。

root: 与古英语 sceald（浅滩）相关，核心义「上下距离很短」。

sensesIntro.en: Shallow means not deep in water, breath, or thought, or a shallow place.
sensesIntro.cn: shallow 意为水浅、呼吸浅、思想浅，或浅滩。

core.en: A short distance from surface to bottom.
core.cn: 从表面到底部的距离很短。

branches.en: Water close to its bed.
A mind that stays near the surface.
Breath that goes only a little way.
branches.cn: 只进入很浅位置的呼吸。

branches.en: A place where water is shallow.
Water and thought share the idea of depth.
branches.cn: 水与思想共享深度的概念。

intro.en: Shallow builds words for degree, manner, and shallow places.
intro.cn: shallow 构成表示程度、方式和浅处的词。

latinIntro.en: Shallow has no Latin ancestor; Latin brevis, short, is only a semantic parallel.
latinIntro.cn: shallow 没有拉丁语来源；拉丁语 brevis（短）只是语义对应词。

items.example: The shallowness of the pond is visible.

definition_en: a painful feeling of having done wrong, a cause of disgrace, or to make someone feel ashamed
core_image: 被当众指出错误，脸一下子烧起来
scene: 他因说谎而感到羞愧。He felt shame for lying.
sceneCN: 这里 shame 是「羞愧」（第 1 个义项）；句意：他因说谎而感到羞愧。

senses.title: Painful feeling
senses.definition: a painful feeling caused by knowing you did wrong
senses.definitionCN: 因知道自己做错而感到的痛苦
senses.example: He felt shame for lying.
senses.why: This is the central emotional sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是核心的情感义项。

senses.title: Disgrace
senses.definition: loss of honour or respect
senses.example: The scandal brought shame on the family.
senses.why: Shame can be a public state, not only a private feeling.
senses.whyCN: 羞耻可以是公开的状态，而不只是私人感受。

senses.title: To make ashamed
senses.definition: to make someone feel shame
senses.example: She was shamed by his words.
senses.why: The noun became a verb of causing the feeling.
senses.whyCN: 名词转化为引起这种感觉的动词。

senses.title: A pity
senses.definition: something unfortunate, used in informal speech
senses.example: It is a shame you cannot come.
senses.why: A mild regret is softened by the word shame.
senses.whyCN: 轻微的遗憾用 shame 来缓和。

intro.en: Shame comes from Old English sceamu, a Germanic word for the feeling of disgrace.
intro.cn: shame 源自古英语 sceamu，是日耳曼语中表示羞耻感的词。

items.en: The root named a sense of disgrace.
items.cn: 这个词根指羞耻感。

items.en: Sceamu meant shame or modesty.
items.cn: sceamu 意为羞耻或谦逊。

items.en: Shame named both feeling and disgrace.
items.cn: shame 既指感受也指耻辱。

items.en: The verb meant to bring shame on someone.
items.cn: 动词形式意为使某人蒙羞。

items.en: The phrase a shame came to mean a pity.
items.cn: 短语 a shame 开始表示可惜。

note.en: Shame is compared with similar-looking words and with words for disgrace.
note.cn: 把 shame 与形近词以及表示耻辱的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Shame is the heat of being seen doing wrong, and the social mark it leaves.
normalIntro.cn: shame 是被看见做错事时的灼热感，以及它留下的社会印记。

normal.en: He hung his head in shame.
The lie brought shame on him.
It is a shame she left early.
Shame can stop people from repeating mistakes.
normal.cn: 羞耻能阻止人们重犯错误。

abstract.en: Shame is a mirror held by other people.
abstract.cn: 羞耻是别人举起的镜子。

abstract.en: Too much shame can teach the wrong lesson.
abstract.cn: 过多的羞耻可能教错道理。

abstract.en: A pity and a disgrace share one small word.
abstract.cn: 可惜与耻辱共用一个不起眼的词。

examples.en: He felt shame for lying.
The scandal brought shame on the family.
It is a shame you cannot come.

dict_mnemonic.text: shame 源自古英语 sceamu（羞耻），核心义「被看见做错时的痛苦」，由私人感受引申为公开耻辱与可惜。

root: 源自古英语 sceamu（羞耻、谦逊），核心义「做错事后被看见的痛苦」。

sensesIntro.en: Shame means the pain of wrongdoing, public disgrace, to make someone ashamed, or a pity.
sensesIntro.cn: shame 意为做错事的痛苦、公开耻辱、使某人羞愧或憾事。

core.en: The pain of being seen as wrong.
core.cn: 被看作做错事时的痛苦。

branches.en: A burning private feeling.
A public loss of honour.
The act of making another feel it.
branches.cn: 使他人产生这种感觉的行为。

branches.en: A softened word for regret.
Private pain and public disgrace share one word.
branches.cn: 私人痛苦与公开耻辱共用一个词。

intro.en: Shame builds words for the presence or absence of shame.
intro.cn: shame 构成表示有羞耻或无羞耻的词。

latinIntro.en: Shame has no Latin ancestor; Latin pudor, a sense of shame, is only a semantic parallel.
latinIntro.cn: shame 没有拉丁语来源；拉丁语 pudor（羞耻感）只是语义对应词。

items.example: She felt shamed by the comment.

items.exampleCN: 无耻的谎言让我们震惊。

definition_en: the outer form of something, to give something a form, or the condition of something
core_image: 双手把湿泥捏成一只碗的弧线
scene: 云朵慢慢变成了船的形状。The cloud slowly took the shape of a boat.
sceneCN: 这里 shape 是「形状」（第 1 个义项）；句意：云朵慢慢变成了船的形状。

senses.title: Outer form
senses.definition: the outline or form of something
senses.example: The cloud slowly took the shape of a boat.
senses.exampleCN: 云朵慢慢变成了船的形状。
senses.why: This is the basic visual sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是基本的视觉义项。

senses.title: To form
senses.definition: to give something a particular form
senses.example: She shaped the clay into a bowl.
senses.why: The noun became a verb of forming.
senses.whyCN: 名词转化为成形的动词。

senses.title: Condition
senses.definition: the state of something, especially health
senses.example: He is in good shape this year.
senses.why: The body's form reflects its condition.
senses.whyCN: 身体的外形反映其状况。

senses.title: Influence
senses.definition: to influence how something develops
senses.example: Early years shape character.
senses.why: Shaping is not only physical but also mental.
senses.whyCN: 塑造不仅是物理的，也是心理的。

intro.en: Shape comes from Old English gesceap, creation or form, from the verb sceppan, to create.
intro.cn: shape 源自古英语 gesceap（创造、形态），来自动词 sceppan（创造）。

items.en: The root meant to create or shape.
items.cn: 这个词根意为创造或塑造。

items.en: Sceppan meant to create.
items.cn: sceppan 意为创造。

items.en: Gesceap meant a created form.
items.cn: gesceap 意为被创造的形态。

items.en: Shape named the outline of a thing.
items.cn: shape 指事物的外轮廓。

items.en: The verb meant to form or influence.
items.cn: 动词形式意为塑造或影响形成。

note.en: Shape is compared with similar-looking words and with words for form and outline.
note.cn: 把 shape 与形近词以及表示形态和轮廓的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Shape is an outline you can see, a form you can make, and the condition that form is in.
normalIntro.cn: shape 是看得见的轮廓、能做出的形态，以及形态所处的状况。

normal.en: The table has a round shape.
Clay can be shaped by hand.

abstract.en: A shape is a boundary the eye can hold.
abstract.cn: 形状是眼睛能把握的边界。

abstract.en: To shape is to leave a mark on what will grow.
abstract.cn: 塑造就是在将要生长之物上留下印记。

abstract.en: Condition is a shape you cannot see.
abstract.cn: 状况是你看不见的形状。

examples.en: The cloud slowly took the shape of a boat.
examples.cn: 云朵慢慢变成了船的形状。

examples.en: She shaped the clay into a bowl.
He is in good shape this year.

dict_mnemonic.text: shape 源自古英语 gesceap（创造出的形态），核心义「被造出的轮廓」，由形状引申为塑造与状况。

root: 源自古英语 gesceap（创造、形态），核心义「被造出的外轮廓」。

sensesIntro.en: Shape means an outer form, to form something, a condition, or to influence development.
sensesIntro.cn: shape 意为形状、塑造、状况或影响形成。

core.en: An outline that holds a thing together.
core.cn: 把事物组织起来的外轮廓。

branches.en: The visible outline of a thing.
The act of giving form.
The state a body is in.
Influence on how something grows.
branches.cn: 对某物如何生长的影响。

branches.en: The form and the forming share one word.
branches.cn: 形态与塑形共用一个词。

intro.en: Shape builds words for forms, their absence, and their beauty.
intro.cn: shape 构成表示形态、形态缺失和形态之美的词。

latinIntro.en: Shape has no Latin ancestor; Latin forma, form, is only a semantic parallel.
latinIntro.cn: shape 没有拉丁语来源；拉丁语 forma（形状）只是语义对应词。

items.example: The tiles come in many shapes.
The handle is shaped like a hook.

items.exampleCN: 他穿着一件没有形的外套。

items.example: The vase has a shapely neck.

definition_en: to give part of something to others, to use something together, a portion of something, or a unit of ownership in a company
core_image: 一块饼被切开，每人手里拿到相同的一角
scene: 她把蛋糕分给每个孩子。She shared the cake with every child.
sceneCN: 这里 share 是「分享」（第 1 个义项）；句意：她把蛋糕分给每个孩子。

senses.title: Give a part
senses.definition: to give part of something to other people
senses.definitionCN: 把某物的一部分给别人
senses.example: She shared the cake with every child.
senses.exampleCN: 她把蛋糕分给每个孩子。
senses.why: This is the everyday social sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是日常社交义项。

senses.title: Use together
senses.definition: to use something with another person
senses.example: They share a small office.
senses.exampleCN: 他们合用一间小办公室。
senses.why: Sharing can mean joint use rather than division.
senses.whyCN: 分享也可以指共同使用而非分割。

senses.title: Portion
senses.definition: a part of something that belongs to one person
senses.definitionCN: 某物中属于某个人的部分
senses.example: Everyone got a fair share.
senses.exampleCN: 每个人都得到公平的一份。
senses.why: The act of dividing produces shares.
senses.whyCN: 分割的行为产生了份额。

senses.title: Company stock
senses.definition: one of the equal parts of a company's ownership
senses.definitionCN: 公司所有权中均等的一份
senses.example: He bought shares in the company.
senses.exampleCN: 他买了这家公司的股份。
senses.why: Ownership is divided into shares like a cake.
senses.whyCN: 所有权像蛋糕一样被分成份额。

intro.en: Share comes from Old English scearu, a cutting or division, related to shear.
intro.cn: share 源自古英语 scearu（切分、份额），与 shear（剪）相关。

items.en: The root meant to cut or divide.
items.cn: 这个词根意为切或分。

items.en: Scearu meant a division or portion.
items.cn: scearu 意为分割或份额。

items.en: Share named a part given to someone.
items.cn: share 指分给某人的一份。

items.en: The verb meant to divide among people.
items.cn: 动词形式意为在人们之间分配。

items.en: Share named a unit of company ownership.
items.cn: share 指公司所有权的一份。

note.en: Share is compared with similar-looking words and with words for dividing.
note.cn: 把 share 与形近词以及表示分配的词作比较。

entries.definition: to cut wool from a sheep

normalIntro.en: To share is to cut a whole into parts and let others hold them.
normalIntro.cn: share 就是把整体切成部分，让别人也拿着。

normal.en: Each child had a share of the pie.
normal.cn: 每个孩子都分到一份派。

normal.en: She owns shares in a bank.

abstract.en: A share is a piece of a whole that stays connected.
abstract.cn: 份额是整体中仍相连的一块。

abstract.en: Sharing makes one thing serve many.
abstract.cn: 分享让一样东西服务许多人。

abstract.en: Fair division is harder than cutting.
abstract.cn: 公平分配比切割更难。

examples.en: She shared the cake with every child.
examples.cn: 她把蛋糕分给每个孩子。

examples.en: They share a small office.
examples.cn: 他们合用一间小办公室。

examples.en: He bought shares in the company.
examples.cn: 他买了这家公司的股份。

dict_mnemonic.text: share 源自古英语 scearu（切分、份额），核心义「切开后的一份」，由分配引申为合用与股份。

root: 源自古英语 scearu（切分、份额），与 shear（剪）同源，核心义「分出来的一份」。

sensesIntro.en: Share means to give part away, to use together, a portion, or a unit of stock.
sensesIntro.cn: share 意为分给他人、合用、份额或股份。

core.en: A part cut from a whole.
core.cn: 从整体中切出的一份。

branches.en: Giving part of what you have.
Using one thing together.
The piece that belongs to one.
Ownership divided into units.
branches.cn: 被分成单位的公司所有权。

branches.en: The act and the portion share one word.
branches.cn: 分配动作与所得份额共用一个词。

intro.en: Share builds words for joint use, investors, and distribution.
intro.cn: share 构成表示共用、投资者和分配的词。

latinIntro.en: Share has no Latin ancestor; Latin pars, a part, is only a semantic parallel.
latinIntro.cn: share 没有拉丁语来源；拉丁语 pars（部分）只是语义对应词。

definition_zh: 锋利的；敏锐的；急剧的；准时地
definition_en: having a fine edge, quick to notice things, sudden and large, or exactly at a stated time
core_image: 刀刃划过纸面，几乎听不到阻力
scene: 这把刀很锋利，切菜很快。The knife is sharp and cuts quickly.
sceneCN: 这里 sharp 是「锋利的」（第 1 个义项）；句意：这把刀很锋利，切菜很快。

senses.title: Fine edge
senses.definition: having an edge that cuts easily
senses.example: The knife is sharp and cuts quickly.
senses.exampleCN: 这把刀很锋利，切菜很快。
senses.why: This is the basic physical sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是基本的物理义项。

senses.title: Quick to notice
senses.definition: able to understand or notice things quickly
senses.definitionCN: 能迅速理解或察觉事物的
senses.example: She has a sharp mind.
senses.why: A cutting edge became a metaphor for quick thought.
senses.whyCN: 锋刃被隐喻为敏捷的思维。

senses.title: Sudden and large
senses.definition: changing suddenly and by a large amount
senses.example: There was a sharp rise in prices.
senses.why: A sharp movement is abrupt like a blade.
senses.whyCN: 急剧的变化像刀刃一样突然。

senses.title: Exactly
senses.definition: exactly at a stated time
senses.example: The meeting starts at nine sharp.
senses.why: The time is cut precisely, with no margin.
senses.whyCN: 时间被精确切定，没有余量。

intro.en: Sharp comes from Old English scearp, a Germanic word for cutting and pointed things.
intro.cn: sharp 源自古英语 scearp，是日耳曼语中表示切割与尖利的词。

items.en: The root meant cutting or pointed.
items.cn: 这个词根意为切割或尖利。

items.en: Scearp meant having a fine edge.
items.cn: scearp 意为有锋利边缘的。

items.en: Sharp also described keen senses.
items.cn: sharp 也形容敏锐的感官。

items.en: Sharp described sudden changes.
items.cn: sharp 形容突然的变化。

items.en: The adverb meant exactly on time.
items.cn: 副词形式意为正好准时。

note.en: Sharp is compared with similar-looking words and with words for keenness.
note.cn: 把 sharp 与形近词以及表示锐利的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Sharp is a fine edge: it cuts food, cuts through confusion, cuts a change short, and cuts time exactly.
normalIntro.cn: sharp 是一条细刃：切食物、切开困惑、截断变化、精确切定时间。

abstract.en: A sharp edge works by concentrating force.
abstract.cn: 锋刃通过集中力量来起作用。

abstract.en: A sharp mind cuts problems into parts.
abstract.cn: 敏锐的头脑把问题切成部分。

abstract.en: Sharp changes are easy to see and hard to stop.
abstract.cn: 急剧变化容易看见，却难以阻止。

examples.en: The knife is sharp and cuts quickly.
examples.cn: 这把刀很锋利，切菜很快。

examples.en: She has a sharp mind.
The meeting starts at nine sharp.

dict_mnemonic.text: sharp 源自古英语 scearp（锋利），核心义「边缘细而能切」，由刀锋引申为思维敏锐、变化急剧与时间精确。

root: 源自古英语 scearp（锋利、尖利），核心义「能切开的细边」。

sensesIntro.en: Sharp means having a fine edge, quick in thought, sudden and large, or exactly on time.
sensesIntro.cn: sharp 意为锋利的、思维敏锐的、急剧的或正好准时的。

core.en: A narrow edge that cuts.
core.cn: 能切割的狭窄边缘。

branches.en: A blade that cuts easily.
A mind that cuts to the point.
A change with a steep edge.
A time cut with no margin.
Blades and minds are both called sharp.
branches.cn: 刀刃与头脑都被称为 sharp。

intro.en: Sharp builds words for comparison, sharpening, and keen sight.
intro.cn: sharp 构成表示比较、磨利和目光敏锐的词。

latinIntro.en: Sharp has no Latin ancestor; Latin acutus, sharp, is only a semantic parallel.
latinIntro.cn: sharp 没有拉丁语来源；拉丁语 acutus（尖锐的）只是语义对应词。

items.example: It is the sharpest tool here.
items.exampleCN: 这是这里最锋利的工具。

items.example: The sharpness of the turn surprised us.

items.exampleCN: 一名目光敏锐的警卫看见了他。

definition_en: suddenly and by a large amount, in a severe way, or in a clear and distinct way
core_image: 折线在图表上突然向上折起
scene: 价格急剧上涨。Prices rose sharply.
sceneCN: 这里 sharply 是「急剧地」（第 1 个义项）；句意：价格急剧上涨。

senses.title: Sudden and large
senses.definition: by a large amount in a short time
senses.example: Prices rose sharply.
senses.why: This is the most common use in news and reports.
senses.whyCN: 这是新闻和报告中最常见的用法。

senses.title: Severely
senses.definition: in a severe or critical way
senses.example: The teacher spoke sharply to the class.
senses.exampleCN: 老师严厉地对全班说话。
senses.why: A sharp tone cuts like a blade.
senses.whyCN: 尖锐的语气像刀刃一样切割。

senses.title: Clearly
senses.definition: in a clear and distinct way
senses.example: The two colours contrast sharply.
senses.exampleCN: 两种颜色形成鲜明对比。
senses.why: A sharp outline is easy to see.
senses.whyCN: 清晰的轮廓容易看见。

intro.en: Sharply is simply sharp plus the adverb ending -ly.
intro.cn: sharply 就是 sharp 加上副词后缀 -ly。

items.en: Scearp meant having a fine edge.
items.cn: scearp 意为有锋利的边缘。

items.en: Sharp described keen senses and tones.
items.cn: sharp 形容敏锐的感官和语气。

items.en: The adverb sharply described cutting speech.
items.cn: 副词 sharply 形容尖刻的言语。

items.en: Sharply described sudden changes in numbers.
items.cn: sharply 形容数字的突然变化。

items.en: Sharply also marks a clear contrast.
items.cn: sharply 也标记鲜明的对比。

note.en: Sharply is compared with similar-looking words and with adverbs for sudden change.
note.cn: 把 sharply 与形近词以及表示突然变化的副词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Sharply adds a cutting edge to a verb: prices cut upward, words cut deep, lines cut clear.
normalIntro.cn: sharply 给动词加上刀刃：价格向上切、话语切得深、线条切得分明。

abstract.en: A sharp change leaves a mark on the chart.
abstract.cn: 急剧变化会在图表上留下痕迹。

abstract.en: Sharp words are remembered longer than loud ones.
abstract.cn: 尖锐的话比大声的话被记得更久。

abstract.en: Clarity is a kind of sharpness.
abstract.cn: 清晰也是一种锋利。

examples.en: Prices rose sharply.
The teacher spoke sharply to the class.
examples.cn: 老师严厉地对全班说话。

examples.en: The two colours contrast sharply.
examples.cn: 两种颜色形成鲜明对比。

dict_mnemonic.text: sharply 是 sharp（锋利）加 -ly，核心义「像刀刃一样突然、尖锐而分明」。

root: 由 sharp（锋利）加副词后缀 -ly 构成，核心义「带刃地、急剧地」。

sensesIntro.en: Sharply means by a large sudden amount, severely, or clearly.
sensesIntro.cn: sharply 意为急剧地、严厉地或清晰地。

core.en: With the force of a cutting edge.
core.cn: 带着刀刃般的力量。

branches.en: A change that cuts upward or down.
Speech that cuts the listener.
An outline that cuts cleanly.
Suddenness and clarity both come from edge.
branches.cn: 突然与清晰都来自刀刃。

branches.en: Tone and contrast can both be sharp.
branches.cn: 语气与对比都能是尖锐的。

intro.en: Sharply belongs to the sharp family of edges and keenness.
intro.cn: sharply 属于 sharp 这一表示刀刃与锐利的词族。

latinIntro.en: Sharply has no Latin ancestor; Latin acriter, sharply, is only a semantic parallel.
latinIntro.cn: sharply 没有拉丁语来源；拉丁语 acriter（尖锐地）只是语义对应词。

items.example: The sharpness of the image is good.
The sharpener is on the desk.
A sharp-eyed reader found the error.
items.exampleCN: 一位目光敏锐的读者发现了错误。

definition_en: to cut hair from the skin, to cut a thin piece off, to reduce a small amount, or the act of shaving
core_image: 剃刀贴着下巴滑下，留下一道干净的白痕
scene: 他每天早上刮胡子。He shaves every morning.
sceneCN: 这里 shave 是「刮胡子」（第 1 个义项）；句意：他每天早上刮胡子。

senses.title: Cut hair
senses.definition: to cut hair from the face or body
senses.definitionCN: 把脸上或身上的毛剃掉
senses.example: He shaves every morning.
senses.why: This is the everyday personal care sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是日常个人护理义项。

senses.title: Slice off
senses.definition: to cut a thin piece from a surface
senses.example: He shaved a thin slice of cheese.
senses.why: The razor motion is applied to any thin slice.
senses.whyCN: 剃刀的动作被用于任何薄片。

senses.title: Reduce slightly
senses.definition: to reduce an amount by a small degree
senses.example: They shaved ten percent off the price.
senses.exampleCN: 他们把价格削减了百分之十。
senses.why: A thin slice removed is a small reduction.
senses.whyCN: 削掉薄薄一层就是小幅减少。

senses.title: A close shave
senses.definition: a narrow escape from danger
senses.example: That was a close shave.
senses.why: The phrase comes from passing very near the razor.
senses.whyCN: 这个短语来自险些被剃刀刮到。

intro.en: Shave comes from Old English sceafan, to scrape or cut hair.
intro.cn: shave 源自古英语 sceafan，意为刮或剃。

items.en: The root meant to scrape or cut.
items.cn: 这个词根意为刮或切。

items.en: Sceafan meant to scrape hair from skin.
items.cn: sceafan 意为从皮肤上刮去毛发。

items.en: Shave also meant to cut a thin piece.
items.cn: shave 也指削下薄片。

items.en: The verb meant to reduce a small amount.
items.cn: 动词形式意为小幅削减。

items.en: A close shave became an idiom for near danger.
items.cn: a close shave 成为险遭不测的习语。

note.en: Shave is compared with similar-looking words and with words for cutting and trimming.
note.cn: 把 shave 与形近词以及表示切割和修整的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Shave is a blade taking a very thin layer: hair, cheese, or a price.
normalIntro.cn: shave 是用刀削下极薄一层：毛发、奶酪或价格。

normal.cn: 没刮胡子的脸显得疲惫。

abstract.en: A thin cut can change the whole shape.
abstract.cn: 薄薄一削也能改变整体形状。

abstract.en: Small reductions are easy to miss.
abstract.cn: 小幅削减容易被忽略。

abstract.en: Near danger is measured by a hair's width.
abstract.cn: 险境的距离只有一根发丝那么宽。

examples.en: He shaves every morning.
He shaved a thin slice of cheese.
That was a close shave.

dict_mnemonic.text: shave 源自古英语 sceafan（刮、剃），核心义「用刀刮去薄薄一层」，再引申为削减与险遭不测。

root: 源自古英语 sceafan（刮、剃），核心义「削去表面薄层」。

sensesIntro.en: Shave means to cut hair, slice off a thin piece, reduce slightly, or a narrow escape.
sensesIntro.cn: shave 意为剃毛、削下薄片、小幅削减或侥幸脱险。

core.en: To remove a very thin layer with a blade.
core.cn: 用刀去掉极薄的一层。

branches.en: Hair removed from the face.
A thin slice cut from food.
A small amount taken off a total.
branches.cn: 从总量中减去的小数目。

branches.en: Passing within a hair of danger.
Hair and costs are both shaved away.

intro.en: Shave builds words for tools, acts, and the state of being shaved.
intro.cn: shave 构成表示工具、动作和剃过状态的词。

latinIntro.en: Shave has no Latin ancestor; Latin radere, to scrape, is only a semantic parallel.
latinIntro.cn: shave 没有拉丁语来源；拉丁语 radere（刮）只是语义对应词。

items.meaning: the act or a thin piece

items.exampleCN: 他显得疲惫且没刮胡子。

definition_en: the pronoun used for a woman or girl already mentioned
core_image: 一位女性侧过身，长发在肩后划过
scene: 她明天会来。She will come tomorrow.
sceneCN: 这里 she 是「她」（第 1 个义项）；句意：她明天会来。

senses.title: Female person
senses.definition: the pronoun for a woman or girl already mentioned
senses.definitionCN: 指代已提到的女性或女孩的代词
senses.example: She said she would come tomorrow.
senses.why: This is the basic grammatical sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是基本的语法义项。

senses.title: Female animal
senses.definition: the pronoun for a female animal
senses.example: The mare is old; she still works.
senses.exampleCN: 那匹母马老了，她仍在干活。
senses.why: Animals with known sex are often called he or she.
senses.whyCN: 已知性别的动物常用 he 或 she。

senses.title: Ship or country
senses.definition: a traditional pronoun for ships, countries, or machines
senses.definitionCN: 传统上指代船只、国家或机器的代词
senses.example: The ship lost her mast.
senses.why: An old convention treats these as female.
senses.whyCN: 旧习惯把这些事物视为女性。

intro.en: She comes from Old English heo, the feminine subject pronoun.
intro.cn: she 源自古英语 heo，是阴性主格代词。

items.en: The root was the feminine subject pronoun.
items.cn: 这个词根是阴性主格代词。

items.en: Heo meant she.
items.cn: heo 意为她。

items.en: She replaced heo in northern dialects.
items.cn: she 在北部方言中取代了 heo。

items.en: She spread through standard English.
items.cn: she 传播到标准英语中。

items.en: She also names female animals and ships.
items.cn: she 也指雌性动物和船只。

note.en: She is compared with similar-looking words and with other pronouns.
note.cn: 把 she 与形近词以及其他代词作比较。

normalIntro.en: She points to one female person already in the sentence or the scene.
normalIntro.cn: she 指向句中或场景里已经出现的一位女性。

abstract.en: A pronoun is a small hand pointing back.
abstract.cn: 代词是一只向后指的小手。

abstract.en: She carries a whole person in three letters.
abstract.cn: she 用三个字母承载一个人。

abstract.en: The word changes with the grammar, not the person.
abstract.cn: 这个词随语法变化，而不随人变化。

examples.en: She said she would come tomorrow.
The mare is old; she still works.
examples.cn: 那匹母马老了，她仍在干活。

examples.en: The ship lost her mast.

dict_mnemonic.text: she 源自古英语 heo（她），是英语最基本的阴性主格代词，另有宾格 her 与所有格 hers。

root: 源自古英语 heo（她），核心义「已提到的女性」。

sensesIntro.en: She is the subject pronoun for a woman, a female animal, or traditionally a ship.
sensesIntro.cn: she 是女性、雌性动物或传统上船只的主格代词。

core.en: A pointer to a female already named.
core.cn: 指向已提到的女性的标记。

branches.en: A woman or girl as subject.
branches.cn: 作为主语的女性或女孩。

branches.en: A female animal as subject.
A ship treated as female.
People and animals share the pronoun.
branches.cn: 人与动物共用这个代词。

branches.en: The female pronoun extends to things.

intro.en: She has a small set of related pronoun forms.
intro.cn: she 有一小组相关的代词形式。

latinIntro.en: She has no Latin ancestor; Latin ea, she, is only a semantic parallel.
latinIntro.cn: she 没有拉丁语来源；拉丁语 ea（她）只是语义对应词。

definition_en: a small building for storage, to lose leaves or skin, to let tears fall, or to get rid of something
core_image: 花园角落一间小木棚，门缝里透出工具的影子
scene: 他把工具放进棚屋里。He put the tools in the shed.
sceneCN: 这里 shed 是「棚屋」（第 1 个义项）；句意：他把工具放进棚屋里。

senses.title: Small building
senses.definition: a small simple building used for storage or work
senses.definitionCN: 用于储物或工作的简易小建筑
senses.example: He put the tools in the shed.
senses.why: This is the everyday noun sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是日常名词义项。

senses.title: Drop naturally
senses.definition: to lose leaves, hair, or skin naturally
senses.definitionCN: 自然掉落叶子、毛发或皮肤
senses.example: The tree sheds its leaves in autumn.
senses.why: This is the core verb sense of letting something fall.
senses.whyCN: 这是让某物落下的核心动词义。

senses.title: Let tears fall
senses.definition: to let tears flow
senses.example: She shed a few tears at the end.
senses.why: Tears are shed like leaves.
senses.whyCN: 眼泪像叶子一样被落下。

senses.title: Get rid of
senses.definition: to remove or get rid of something
senses.example: He shed his old habits.
senses.why: What is shed is left behind like old skin.
senses.whyCN: 被脱落的东西像旧皮一样被留下。

intro.en: Shed has two roots: the noun from shade, the verb from Old English sceadan, to separate.
intro.cn: shed 有两个来源：名词来自 shade，动词来自古英语 sceadan（分开）。

items.en: Scead meant shade or a shadowy shelter.
items.cn: scead 意为阴影或阴凉处。

items.en: Sceadan meant to separate or divide.
items.cn: sceadan 意为分开或分离。

items.en: Shed named a small shelter.
items.cn: shed 指小棚屋。

items.en: The verb meant to let something fall off.
items.cn: 动词形式意为让某物脱落。

items.en: Shed light on became a common idiom.
items.cn: shed light on 成为常用习语。

note.en: Shed is compared with similar-looking words and with words for shelters and dropping.
note.cn: 把 shed 与形近词以及表示棚屋和掉落的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: A shed is a small shelter; to shed is to let something leave and fall behind.
normalIntro.cn: shed 是小棚屋；动词 shed 是让某物离开并留在身后。

normal.en: The garden shed is full of tools.
normal.cn: 花园棚屋里放满了工具。

normal.en: The report sheds light on the problem.
He shed his coat and ran.

abstract.en: Growing often means shedding what is no longer needed.
abstract.cn: 成长常常意味着脱掉不再需要的东西。

abstract.en: A shelter is a small roof for large work.
abstract.cn: 棚屋是为大工作准备的小屋顶。

abstract.en: Light can be shed by words.
abstract.cn: 光也可以由言语投下。

examples.en: He put the tools in the shed.
The tree sheds its leaves in autumn.
The report sheds light on the problem.

dict_mnemonic.text: shed 名词与 shade（阴凉处）同源，动词源自 sceadan（分开），核心义「让小东西离开并留下」。

root: 名词与 shade 同源，动词源自古英语 sceadan（分开），核心义「脱落、留下」。

sensesIntro.en: Shed means a small building, to lose leaves or skin, to weep, or to get rid of.
sensesIntro.cn: shed 意为棚屋、脱落、流泪或摆脱。

core.en: To let something fall away and stay behind.
core.cn: 让某物掉落并留在身后。

branches.en: A small roofed shelter.
Leaves or skin falling away.
Tears let fall.
Old things removed.
Natural loss and chosen removal share the verb.
branches.cn: 自然脱落与主动去除共用这个动词。

intro.en: Shed builds a few compounds around shelters and shedding.
intro.cn: shed 围绕棚屋与脱落构成少量复合词。

latinIntro.en: Shed has no Latin ancestor; Latin effundere, to pour out, is only a semantic parallel.
latinIntro.cn: shed 没有拉丁语来源；拉丁语 effundere（倒出）只是语义对应词。

items.example: A shedlike hut stood by the road.
items.exampleCN: 路边立着一间棚屋似的小屋。

definition_en: a farm animal kept for wool and meat, or a person who follows others without thinking
core_image: 一只绵羊低头啃草，厚厚的羊毛像一团云
scene: 羊群在草地上吃草。The sheep grazed on the grass.
sceneCN: 这里 sheep 是「绵羊」（第 1 个义项）；句意：羊群在草地上吃草。

senses.title: Farm animal
senses.definition: a farm animal with thick wool
senses.definitionCN: 长着厚羊毛的农场动物
senses.example: The sheep grazed on the grass.
senses.why: This is the basic animal sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是基本的动物义项。

senses.title: Wool source
senses.definition: the animal as a source of wool or meat
senses.definitionCN: 作为羊毛或肉来源的动物
senses.example: The farm keeps sheep for wool.
senses.why: The animal stands for the product it gives.
senses.whyCN: 动物代指它所提供的产品。

senses.title: Blind follower
senses.definition: a person who follows others without thinking
senses.definitionCN: 不加思考跟随他人的人
senses.example: He is no sheep; he questions everything.
senses.exampleCN: 他不是盲从者，什么都质疑。
senses.why: Sheep are known for moving as a flock.
senses.whyCN: 羊以成群跟从而出名。

intro.en: Sheep comes from Old English sceap, a word shared across the Germanic languages.
intro.cn: sheep 源自古英语 sceap，是日耳曼语各语言共有的词。

items.en: Skap named the wool-bearing animal.
items.cn: skap 指长毛的动物。

items.en: Sceap meant sheep, singular or plural.
items.cn: sceap 单复数同形，意为绵羊。

items.en: Sheep kept the same unchanging plural.
items.cn: sheep 保持不变的复数形式。

items.en: Sheep named the animal and its wool.
items.cn: sheep 指这种动物及其羊毛。

items.en: The word became a metaphor for blind followers.
items.cn: 这个词成为盲从者的隐喻。

note.en: Sheep is compared with similar-looking words and with words for farm animals.
note.cn: 把 sheep 与形近词以及表示农场动物的词作比较。

entries.definition: a flat board for storing things

normalIntro.en: Sheep is the woolly animal that moves as a flock, and a name for people who do the same.
normalIntro.cn: sheep 是成群移动的毛茸茸动物，也指同样盲从的人。

normal.en: The sheep are in the field.
The sheep dog guards the flock.
Do not be a sheep; think first.

abstract.en: A flock is safe and also easy to lead.
abstract.cn: 羊群既安全又容易被带领。

abstract.en: Wool grows by being cut.
abstract.cn: 羊毛因被剪而生长。

abstract.en: One black sheep marks the whole flock.
abstract.cn: 一只黑羊标记了整个羊群。

examples.en: The sheep grazed on the grass.
The farm keeps sheep for wool.
He is no sheep; he questions everything.
examples.cn: 他不是盲从者，什么都质疑。

dict_mnemonic.text: sheep 源自古英语 sceap（绵羊），单复数同形，核心义「成群的毛用动物」，比喻盲从者。

root: 源自古英语 sceap（绵羊），核心义「成群的长毛家畜」。

sensesIntro.en: Sheep means a wool-bearing farm animal or a person who follows blindly.
sensesIntro.cn: sheep 意为产毛的农场动物或盲从者。

core.en: A woolly animal that stays in a flock.
core.cn: 待在群体中的长毛动物。

branches.en: The animal itself.
The wool or meat it gives.
A person who follows like one.
Animal and follower share the image.
branches.cn: 动物与跟从者共享这个意象。

branches.en: The animal and its product share a name.

intro.en: Sheep builds words for herding, enclosures, and shy behaviour.
intro.cn: sheep 构成表示放牧、围栏和羞怯行为的词。

latinIntro.en: Sheep has no Latin ancestor; Latin ovis, sheep, is only a semantic parallel.
latinIntro.cn: sheep 没有拉丁语来源；拉丁语 ovis（羊）只是语义对应词。

items.example: The sheepdog ran behind the flock.
The sheepfold is beside the barn.
The chair is covered with sheepskin.

definition_zh: 纯粹的；陡峭的；极薄的；完全地
definition_en: complete and nothing else, very steep, very thin and transparent, or completely
core_image: 一面几乎垂直的岩壁，从水面直插天空
scene: 悬崖从海面陡然升起。The cliff rises sheer from the sea.
sceneCN: 这里 sheer 是「陡峭的」（第 2 个义项）；句意：悬崖从海面陡然升起。

senses.title: Complete
senses.definition: used to emphasize that something is nothing but what is stated
senses.definitionCN: 强调某事物完全是所说的那样
senses.example: It was sheer luck that we met.
senses.why: This is the most common modern use.
senses.whyCN: 这是现代最常见的用法。

senses.title: Very steep
senses.definition: rising almost straight up
senses.example: The cliff rises sheer from the sea.
senses.why: A sheer face has no slope to hold on to.
senses.whyCN: 陡壁没有任何可攀附的斜坡。

senses.title: Very thin
senses.definition: thin, light, and almost transparent
senses.example: She wore a sheer silk scarf.
senses.exampleCN: 她戴了一条极薄的丝巾。
senses.why: Thin cloth lets light through like clear air.
senses.whyCN: 薄布像清澈空气一样透光。

senses.title: Completely
senses.definition: used as an adverb meaning completely
senses.example: The door was sheer impossible to open.
senses.why: Pure emphasis turns the adjective into an adverb.
senses.whyCN: 纯粹的强调使形容词转为副词。

intro.en: Sheer joins an Old English word for bright and clear with a Norse word for steep.
intro.cn: sheer 把古英语中表示明亮清澈的词与古诺尔斯语中表示陡峭的词合在一起。

items.en: Scir meant bright, clear, or pure.
items.cn: scir 意为明亮、清澈或纯净。

items.en: Skaerr meant clear or clean.
items.cn: skaerr 意为清澈或洁净。

items.en: Schere described thin, clear cloth.
items.cn: schere 形容轻薄透明的布。

items.en: Sheer described a steep, unbroken face.
items.cn: sheer 形容陡峭完整的崖面。

items.en: Sheer became an intensifier meaning complete.
items.cn: sheer 成为表示「完全」的强调词。

note.en: Sheer is compared with similar-looking words and with words for purity and steepness.
note.cn: 把 sheer 与形近词以及表示纯粹和陡峭的词作比较。

entries.definition: to cut wool from a sheep

normalIntro.en: Sheer is what is unstoppable and unmixed: a clean cliff, thin cloth, pure luck.
normalIntro.cn: sheer 是无法阻挡、没有混杂的东西：干净的崖壁、薄布、纯粹的运气。

normal.cn: 其规模之大让我们惊叹。

abstract.en: A sheer face offers no place to stop.
abstract.cn: 陡壁不提供任何停留之处。

abstract.en: Thin cloth shows what clear air hides.
abstract.cn: 薄布显露出清澈空气所隐藏的东西。

abstract.en: Pure luck looks like skill from outside.
abstract.cn: 纯粹的运气从外面看像技巧。

examples.en: The cliff rises sheer from the sea.
It was sheer luck that we met.
She wore a sheer silk scarf.
examples.cn: 她戴了一条极薄的丝巾。

dict_mnemonic.text: sheer 兼有「清澈纯净」与「陡直」两源，核心义「没有任何混杂或折角」。

root: 由古英语 scir（明亮清澈）与古诺尔斯语 skaerr（纯净）汇合，核心义「纯粹、陡直」。

sensesIntro.en: Sheer means complete, very steep, very thin, or completely.
sensesIntro.cn: sheer 意为纯粹的、陡峭的、极薄的或完全地。

core.en: Nothing mixed in and nothing in the way.
core.cn: 没有混杂，也没有遮挡。

branches.en: Luck with nothing else added.
A face with no slope.
Cloth that lets light through.
Emphasis with no reservation.
Purity and emphasis share one word.
branches.cn: 纯粹与强调共用一个词。

intro.en: Sheer has a small family of degree and steepness.
intro.cn: sheer 有一个表示程度与陡峭的小词族。

latinIntro.en: Sheer has no Latin ancestor; Latin merus, pure, is only a semantic parallel.
latinIntro.cn: sheer 没有拉丁语来源；拉丁语 merus（纯粹的）只是语义对应词。

items.example: This is the sheerest part of the cliff.
The sheerness of the rock surprised us.
items.exampleCN: 岩石的陡峭让我们惊讶。

items.example: The boat sheered away from the rocks.
The ship kept sheering in the wind.

definition_en: a large cloth for a bed, a thin flat piece of material, a single piece of paper, or to cover something
core_image: 一张床单被风鼓起，像一面柔软的帆
scene: 她换了床单。She changed the sheets.
sceneCN: 这里 sheet 是「床单」（第 1 个义项）；句意：她换了床单。

senses.title: Bed cloth
senses.definition: a large cloth used on a bed
senses.example: She changed the sheets.
senses.why: This is the most familiar household sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是最熟悉的家庭义项。

senses.title: Thin flat piece
senses.definition: a wide thin piece of material
senses.example: The roof is covered with metal sheets.
senses.why: A sheet is flat and wide like cloth.
senses.whyCN: 薄板像布一样平而宽。

senses.title: Piece of paper
senses.definition: a single piece of paper
senses.example: Write your name on the sheet.
senses.why: Paper is counted in sheets.
senses.whyCN: 纸张以张为单位计数。

senses.title: To cover
senses.definition: to cover something with a sheet or layer
senses.definitionCN: 用布或层状物覆盖某物
senses.example: Rain sheeted across the field.
senses.why: The noun became a verb of spreading over.
senses.whyCN: 名词转化为铺展覆盖的动词。

intro.en: Sheet comes from Old English sceata, a corner or piece of cloth.
intro.cn: sheet 源自古英语 sceata，意为布的一角或一块。

items.en: The root named a piece of cloth.
items.cn: 这个词根指一块布。

items.en: Sceata meant a corner or sheet of cloth.
items.cn: sceata 意为布角或布片。

items.en: Sheet named a large bed cloth.
items.cn: sheet 指大块床布。

items.en: Sheet named any broad thin surface.
items.cn: sheet 指任何宽薄的表面。

items.en: Paper and ice were counted in sheets.
items.cn: 纸张和冰层以 sheet 计量。

note.en: Sheet is compared with similar-looking words and with words for layers and cloth.
note.cn: 把 sheet 与形近词以及表示层和布的词作比较。

entries.definition: a flat piece over a surface
a flat board in a frame

normalIntro.en: A sheet is one wide flat piece: cloth for a bed, paper for writing, metal for a roof.
normalIntro.cn: sheet 是一大片平坦之物：铺床的布、写字的纸、盖屋顶的金属板。

normal.cn: 雨水成片顺着窗户流下。

abstract.en: A sheet is a surface that has given up depth.
abstract.cn: 薄片是放弃了深度的表面。

abstract.en: One sheet of paper can hold a whole argument.
abstract.cn: 一张纸可以承载整套论证。

abstract.en: Cloth and metal obey the same flat shape.
abstract.cn: 布与金属遵循同样的平坦形状。

examples.en: She changed the sheets.
The roof is covered with metal sheets.
Write your name on the sheet.

dict_mnemonic.text: sheet 源自古英语 sceata（布片），核心义「宽而薄的一片」，由床单推及纸张、金属板与冰盖。

root: 源自古英语 sceata（布的一角、一片），核心义「宽薄的平面物」。

sensesIntro.en: Sheet means a bed cloth, a thin flat piece, a piece of paper, or to cover.
sensesIntro.cn: sheet 意为床单、薄片、一张纸或覆盖。

core.en: One broad, flat piece of something.
core.cn: 某物宽而平的一片。

branches.en: Cloth spread on a bed.
A wide thin panel of material.
One piece of paper.
A layer spreading over a surface.
Cloth and paper are both counted in sheets.

intro.en: Sheet builds words for coverings, paper, and flat materials.
intro.cn: sheet 构成表示覆盖物、纸张和平材料的词。

latinIntro.en: Sheet has no Latin ancestor; Latin scheda, a sheet of paper, is only a semantic parallel.
latinIntro.cn: sheet 没有拉丁语来源；拉丁语 scheda（纸页）只是语义对应词。

items.example: The rock has a sheetlike structure.

items.exampleCN: 这个箱子是金属薄板做的。

definition_en: a flat board fixed to a wall or in a frame for holding things, or a ledge of rock under water
core_image: 一块木板钉在墙上，上面排着一列书
scene: 他把书放回架上。He put the book back on the shelf.
sceneCN: 这里 shelf 是「架子」（第 1 个义项）；句意：他把书放回架上。

senses.title: Board
senses.definition: a flat board used to hold things
senses.example: He put the book back on the shelf.
senses.why: This is the basic furniture sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是基本的家具义项。

senses.title: Shelving unit
senses.definition: a set of shelves in a frame
senses.example: The shelf is full of jars.
senses.why: The board stands for the whole unit.
senses.whyCN: 一块板代指整套架子。

senses.title: Rock ledge
senses.definition: a flat ledge of rock, especially under water
senses.definitionCN: 平坦的岩台，尤指水下的
senses.example: The ship hit a shelf of rock.
senses.why: Nature builds shelves too.
senses.whyCN: 自然也会造出平台。

senses.title: Put aside
senses.definition: left unused or delayed, as in on the shelf
senses.definitionCN: 被闲置或推迟，如 on the shelf
senses.example: The plan is on the shelf for now.
senses.why: Something on a shelf is set aside for later.
senses.whyCN: 放在架上的东西被留待以后。

intro.en: Shelf comes from Middle English shelfe, from Old English scylfe, a ledge.
intro.cn: shelf 源自古英语 scylfe（岩台、搁板），中古英语作 shelfe。

items.en: Scylfe meant a ledge or board.
items.cn: scylfe 意为岩台或搁板。

items.en: Shelfe named a board for holding things.
items.cn: shelfe 指放东西的板。

items.en: Shelf named a rock ledge under water.
items.cn: shelf 指水下的岩台。

items.en: Shelf life named how long goods last.
items.cn: shelf life 指商品的保质期。

items.en: On the shelf meant set aside.
items.cn: on the shelf 意为被搁置。

note.en: Shelf is compared with similar-looking words and with words for ledges and racks.
note.cn: 把 shelf 与形近词以及表示岩台和架子结构的词作比较。

entries.definition: a long flat surface in a shop

normalIntro.en: A shelf is a flat board that holds things, whether on a wall or under the sea.
normalIntro.cn: shelf 是托住东西的平板，无论在墙上还是在海底。

normal.en: The books are on the top shelf.
Put the jars on the shelf.
The ship struck a rock shelf.
The proposal is on the shelf.
Check the shelf life of the milk.

abstract.en: A shelf holds things without owning them.
abstract.cn: 架子托住东西，却不拥有它们。

abstract.en: Setting something aside can be a decision.
abstract.cn: 把东西搁起来也可以是一种决定。

abstract.en: The sea keeps shelves no one can see.
abstract.cn: 大海保留着无人能见的岩台。

examples.en: He put the book back on the shelf.
The shelf is full of jars.
The ship hit a shelf of rock.

dict_mnemonic.text: shelf 源自古英语 scylfe（岩台、搁板），核心义「伸出的平板」，由家具架引申为水下岩礁与搁置。

root: 源自古英语 scylfe（岩台、搁板），核心义「水平伸出的承托面」。

sensesIntro.en: Shelf means a flat board, a shelving unit, an underwater ledge, or a state of being set aside.
sensesIntro.cn: shelf 意为搁板、架子、水下岩礁或被搁置状态。

core.en: A flat surface that holds things out from a base.
core.cn: 从基座伸出的承托平面。

branches.en: A board holding objects.
A whole frame of boards.
A natural rock terrace.
Something left waiting on a shelf.
Holding and postponing share the same board.
branches.cn: 承托与搁置共享同一块板。

intro.en: Shelf builds words for furniture, storage, and delay.
intro.cn: shelf 构成表示家具、储物和延迟的词。

latinIntro.en: Shelf has no Latin ancestor; Latin pluteus, a shelf, is only a semantic parallel.
latinIntro.cn: shelf 没有拉丁语来源；拉丁语 pluteus（搁板）只是语义对应词。

definition_en: a hard outer case, an explosive projectile, to remove such a case, or to attack with shells
core_image: 一只海螺壳贴在耳边，里面传出海的声音
scene: 她在沙滩上捡到一个贝壳。She found a shell on the beach.
sceneCN: 这里 shell 是「壳」（第 1 个义项）；句意：她在沙滩上捡到一个贝壳。

senses.title: Hard case
senses.definition: the hard outer covering of an egg, nut, or sea creature
senses.definitionCN: 蛋、坚果或海洋生物的坚硬外壳
senses.example: She found a shell on the beach.
senses.exampleCN: 她在沙滩上捡到一个贝壳。
senses.why: This is the basic natural sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是基本的自然义项。

senses.title: Projectile
senses.definition: a metal case filled with explosive fired from a gun
senses.definitionCN: 从火炮发射的装填炸药的金属弹体
senses.example: An old shell was found in the field.
senses.exampleCN: 田里发现了一枚旧炮弹。
senses.why: A metal case protects what is inside, as a shell does.
senses.whyCN: 金属外壳像壳一样保护内部。

senses.title: Remove the case
senses.definition: to remove the shell from nuts or seafood
senses.example: They shelled the peas.
senses.why: The noun became a verb of removing a case.
senses.whyCN: 名词转化为去壳的动词。

senses.title: Bombard
senses.definition: to attack a place with explosive shells
senses.example: The town was shelled for hours.
senses.why: The projectile became the action of firing it.
senses.whyCN: 弹体转化为发射它的动作。

intro.en: Shell comes from Old English scell, a hard outer covering.
intro.cn: shell 源自古英语 scell，意为坚硬的外壳。

items.en: The root named a hard covering.
items.cn: 这个词根指坚硬的覆盖物。

items.en: Scell meant the shell of an egg or nut.
items.cn: scell 指蛋壳或坚果壳。

items.en: Shell named the case of sea creatures.
items.cn: shell 指海洋生物的外壳。

items.en: Shell named an explosive projectile.
items.cn: shell 指爆炸性弹体。

items.en: The verb meant to remove a shell or to bombard.
items.cn: 动词形式意为去壳或炮击。

note.en: Shell is compared with similar-looking words and with words for coverings.
note.cn: 把 shell 与形近词以及表示外壳的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Shell is a hard outside that protects a soft inside, from eggs to warships.
normalIntro.cn: shell 是保护柔软内部的坚硬外层，从鸡蛋到军舰都一样。

normal.en: The turtle pulled into its shell.

abstract.en: A shell is a boundary that can be left behind.
abstract.cn: 壳是可以被留下的边界。

abstract.en: Protection and weapon share one word.
abstract.cn: 保护与武器共用一个词。

abstract.en: What is empty inside is still a shell.
abstract.cn: 里面空了，仍然是个壳。

examples.en: She found a shell on the beach.
examples.cn: 她在沙滩上捡到一个贝壳。

examples.en: They shelled the peas.
The town was shelled for hours.

dict_mnemonic.text: shell 源自古英语 scell（硬壳），核心义「包住内部的硬外层」，由蛋壳、贝壳引申为弹壳与炮击。

root: 源自古英语 scell（硬壳），核心义「保护内部的坚硬外层」。

sensesIntro.en: Shell means a hard case, a projectile, to remove a case, or to bombard.
sensesIntro.cn: shell 意为硬壳、炮弹、剥壳或炮击。

core.en: A hard outside around a softer inside.
core.cn: 包住柔软内部的坚硬外层。

branches.en: A natural hard covering.
A metal case filled with explosive.
The act of taking a shell off.
The act of firing shells.
The case and the attack share one word.
branches.cn: 弹壳与炮击共用一个词。

intro.en: Shell builds words for animals, weapons, and protection.
intro.cn: shell 构成表示动物、武器和防护的词。

latinIntro.en: Shell has no Latin ancestor; Latin testa, a shell, is only a semantic parallel.
latinIntro.cn: shell 没有拉丁语来源；拉丁语 testa（壳）只是语义对应词。

items.meaning: bombarded or removed from a shell
items.example: Shelled nuts are easier to eat.

items.meaning: a sea animal with a shell
the hard case of a nut
items.example: In a nutshell, the plan works.

definition_en: a place that protects from weather or danger, or to protect someone or find protection
core_image: 暴雨中，几个人挤在公交站小小的顶棚下
scene: 他们在一棵大树下避雨。They sheltered under a large tree.
sceneCN: 这里 shelter 是「躲避」（第 3 个义项）；句意：他们在一棵大树下避雨。

senses.title: Place of protection
senses.definition: a place that protects people from weather or danger
senses.definitionCN: 保护人们免受天气或危险的地方
senses.example: The bus stop was a poor shelter.
senses.exampleCN: 公交站是个简陋的避雨处。
senses.why: This is the basic noun sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是基本的名词义项。

senses.title: To protect
senses.definition: to protect someone or something
senses.example: The wall shelters the garden from wind.
senses.why: The noun became a verb of protecting.
senses.whyCN: 名词转化为保护的动词。

senses.title: To find cover
senses.definition: to go to a place that gives protection
senses.definitionCN: 到能提供保护的地方去
senses.example: They sheltered under a large tree.
senses.exampleCN: 他们在一棵大树下避雨。
senses.why: The same verb can describe the person protected.
senses.whyCN: 同一个动词也可描述受保护的人。

senses.title: Condition of safety
senses.definition: the state of being protected
senses.example: They found shelter from the storm.
senses.exampleCN: 他们找到了躲避暴风雨的地方。
senses.why: A shelter is both a place and a condition.
senses.whyCN: shelter 既是地点也是状态。

intro.en: Shelter comes from Middle English sheltron, a troop or phalanx of soldiers.
intro.cn: shelter 源自中古英语 sheltron，意为士兵的方阵。

items.en: Scildtruma meant a shield troop.
items.cn: scildtruma 意为持盾的队伍。

items.en: Sheltron meant a body of soldiers.
items.cn: sheltron 意为一支士兵队伍。

items.en: Shelter came to mean protection.
items.cn: shelter 开始表示保护。

items.en: Shelter named a building of refuge.
items.cn: shelter 指提供庇护的建筑。

items.en: The verb meant to protect or to hide.
items.cn: 动词形式意为保护或躲避。

note.en: Shelter is compared with similar-looking words and with words for refuge.
note.cn: 把 shelter 与形近词以及表示庇护的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Shelter is a shield for people and things, as a place, an act, or a state.
normalIntro.cn: shelter 是为人与物提供的盾，可以是地点、动作或状态。

normal.en: We took shelter from the rain.
The tree shelters the house from wind.
They built a shelter for the night.
normal.cn: 他们搭了个过夜的棚子。
动物收容所需要志愿者。

normal.en: The old shed sheltered the tools.

abstract.en: A shelter changes the weather without stopping it.
abstract.cn: 避难所改变天气的影响，却不阻止天气。

abstract.en: Protection is often a small roof and a thick wall.
abstract.cn: 保护常常只是小屋顶和厚墙。

abstract.en: To shelter another is to lend them your walls.
abstract.cn: 庇护他人就是把你的墙借给他们。

examples.en: They sheltered under a large tree.
examples.cn: 他们在一棵大树下避雨。

examples.en: The wall shelters the garden from wind.
They found shelter from the storm.
examples.cn: 他们找到了躲避暴风雨的地方。

dict_mnemonic.text: shelter 源自中古英语 sheltron（盾牌方阵），核心义「盾一样的遮挡」，由军队护盾引申为避难所与保护。

root: 源自中古英语 sheltron（盾牌队伍），核心义「提供遮挡的盾」。

sensesIntro.en: Shelter means a protective place, to protect, to take cover, or the state of safety.
sensesIntro.cn: shelter 意为避难所、保护、躲避或受庇护状态。

core.en: A shield between a person and harm.
core.cn: 人与伤害之间的盾。

branches.en: A place that blocks weather.
To stand between harm and another.
To move under cover.
The state of being safe.
The place and the act share one word.
branches.cn: 地点与动作共用一个词。

intro.en: Shelter builds words for protection, its absence, and planted barriers.
intro.cn: shelter 构成表示保护、保护缺失和植物屏障的词。

latinIntro.en: Shelter has no Latin ancestor; Latin protectio, protection, is only a semantic parallel.
latinIntro.cn: shelter 没有拉丁语来源；拉丁语 protectio（保护）只是语义对应词。

items.example: They live in a sheltered valley.
items.exampleCN: 他们住在避风的山谷里。

items.example: The sheltering trees blocked the wind.
The shelterer took in the family.

items.meaning: a line of trees for protection
trees left to protect new growth

definition_en: a broad piece of armour held for defence, something that protects, or to protect someone or something
core_image: 骑士举起一面宽大的木盾挡在身前
scene: 骑士举起了他的盾牌。The knight raised his shield.
sceneCN: 这里 shield 是「盾牌」（第 1 个义项）；句意：骑士举起了他的盾牌。

senses.title: Defensive board

senses.definitionCN: 用来挡住击打的宽大金属板或木板
senses.example: The soldier hid behind his shield.
senses.why: This is the oldest and most concrete sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是最古老也最具体的义项。

senses.title: Protection
senses.definition: a person or thing that gives protection
senses.example: A tax shield saved the company money.
senses.exampleCN: 一项税收保护让公司省了钱。
senses.why: The board becomes any kind of barrier.
senses.whyCN: 盾牌引申为任何一种屏障。

senses.title: To protect
senses.definition: to protect someone or something from harm
senses.definitionCN: 保护某人或某物免受伤害
senses.example: Parents shield children from danger.
senses.exampleCN: 父母保护孩子远离危险。
senses.why: The noun turns into an action.
senses.whyCN: 名词转化为动作。

senses.title: To block
senses.definition: to hold something in front to stop light or view
senses.definitionCN: 把某物挡在前面以遮住光或视线
senses.example: She shielded her eyes from the sun.
senses.why: Protection narrows to blocking sight.
senses.whyCN: 保护义缩小为遮挡视线。

intro.en: Shield comes from an Old English word for a broad board carried in battle.
intro.cn: shield 来自古英语中表示战场上携带的宽板。

items.en: Scield meant a broad board carried for defence.
items.cn: scield 指战斗中携带的宽大防御板。

items.en: Skjoldr had the same shape and meaning.
items.cn: skjoldr 形状与含义都相同。

items.en: Sheld named both a guard in battle and a heraldic field.
items.cn: sheld 既指战阵中的护具，也指纹章上的盾形。

items.cn: shield 扩展到防暴屏障与防护罩。

items.en: Shield became a verb meaning to protect.
items.cn: shield 成为表示保护的动词。

note.en: Shield is compared with similar-looking words and with words for protection.
